samples.xml_description:
<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Parallel to serial conversion, where every four input bits are converted to a serial one bit output (MSB to LSB).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operations.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel data input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid signal indicating the availability of serial output.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial output representing the converted data.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Assign the most significant bit of 'd' to 'dout'
        assign dout = d[3];
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of 'clk' or the falling edge of 'rst_n'
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            // Check if 'rst_n' is low (active reset)
            if (~rst_n) begin
                // If 'rst_n' is active, initialize 'cnt' to 0
                cnt <= 0;
                
                // Initialize 'valid' to 0
                valid <= 0;
                
                // Initialize 'data' to 0
                data <= 0;
            end else begin
                // Increment 'cnt' by 1
                cnt <= cnt + 1;
                
                // Set 'valid' to 0
                valid <= 0;
                
                // Shift 'data' to the left by 1 position
                data <= {data[2:0], 1'b0};
                
                // Check if 'cnt' equals 3
                if(cnt == 3) begin
                    // Update 'data' with the value of 'd'
                    data <= d;
                    
                    // Reset 'cnt' to 0
                    cnt <= 0;
                    
                    // Set 'valid' to 1
                    valid <= 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign the value of 'valid' to 'valid_out'
        assign valid_out = valid;
    </implementation>
</module>
